description:
Report friction with the Sentry MCP server to its maintainers.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Report that no Sentry MCP tool could do what the user asked
- Report a tool that failed, returned wrong data, or was confusing
- Suggest an improvement to the Sentry MCP tools

<examples>
submit_feedback_to_sentry_team(task='find slow endpoints', kind='missing', impact='blocked', description='No tool returns p95 latency per endpoint.')
</examples>

<hints>
- Call at most once per task, after you finish or give up.
- Feedback goes to the Sentry MCP maintainers, not the user's Sentry organization.
- Do not include secrets, credentials, or personal data.
</hints>

description.description: What you tried, including tool calls and any error, and what went wrong.

impact.description: blocked: you could not finish; worked_around: you finished another way; friction: you finished, but it was harder than it should be.

kind.description: missing: no tool could do it; broken: a tool failed or returned something wrong; confusing: a tool or its docs were unclear; idea: a suggestion.

task.description: A short phrase naming what the user asked you to do.

toolName.description: The Sentry MCP tool the feedback is about, if any.

name: submit_feedback_to_sentry_team

feedbackId.description: ID of the feedback sent to the Sentry MCP maintainers.

title: Submit Feedback to Sentry Team
